data.name: Power of the Djinn
data.description: You gain the power of genies to grant wishes. Once per day, you can cast limited wish as a spell-like ability. Such wishes must begin with the words "I wish," and cannot duplicate a wish you have granted within the past 24 hours. If you use this ability to duplicate a spell with a costly material component, you must provide that component.&nl;You also become immune to electricity damage, and can use plane shift once per day to travel to or from the Plane of Air.

raw_tokens.value: Djinni Bloodline ~ Power of the Djinn
Class Feature.Sorcerer Class Feature.Djinni Bloodline ~ Power LVL 20.Sorcerer Bloodline Power.SpecialQuality.Special Quality.Supernatural

You gain the power of genies to grant wishes. Once per day, you can cast limited wish as a spell-like ability. Such wishes must begin with the words "I wish," and cannot duplicate a wish you have granted within the past 24 hours. If you use this ability to duplicate a spell with a costly material component, you must provide that component.&nl;You also become immune to electricity damage, and can use plane shift once per day to travel to or from the Plane of Air.
